title: OshKosh Recalls Baby B'gosh Quilted Jacket Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The snaps can detach, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 38,000 (in addition, about 5,000 were sold in Canada)..

title: Norco Bicycles Recalls Children's Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The cranks can bend or break during use, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 1,050 (In addition 1,750 were sold in Canada).

title: JW Crawford Recalls Children's Rain Ponchos Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: A drawstring in the poncho's hood poses a strangulation hazard to children. Drawstrings can become entangled or caught on playground slides, hand rails, school bus doors or other moving objects, posing a significant strangulation and/or entanglement hazard to children. Units: About 1,300.

title: Kidde Recalls Fire Extinguishers with Plastic Handles Due to Failure to Discharge and Nozzle Detachment: One Death Reported
summary: The fire extinguishers can become clogged or require excessive force to discharge and can fail to activate during a fire emergency. In addition, the nozzle can detach with enough force to pose an impact hazard. Units: About 37.8 million (in addition, 2.7 million in Canada).

title: Dondolo Recalls Children's Sleepwear Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The children's nightgowns and two-piece pajama sets fail to meet the federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 3,100.

title: Little Mass Children's Sleepwear Recalled by Mass Creation Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The children's nightgowns and pajama sets fail to meet flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 2,300.

title: VIV&LUL Recalls Children's Sleepwear Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard; Sold Exclusively at Amazon.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The children's pajamas fail to meet the flammability standard for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 950.

title: Goal Zero Recalls Solar Powered Charging Stations Due to Impact Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The weld connecting the top and bottom posts can fail and allow the top post to fall, posing an impact hazard to nearby consumers. Units: About 118.

title: IKEA Reannounces Recall of MALM and Other Models of Chests and Dressers Due to Serious Tip-over Hazard; 8th Child Fatality Reported; Consumers Urged to Choose Between Refund or Repair
summary: The recalled chests and dressers are unstable if they are not properly anchored to the wall, posing serious tip-over and entrapment hazards that can result in injuries or death to children. title: Omega Pacific Recalls Carabiners Due to Risk of Injury or Death
summary: The carabiner can break while in use, posing a risk of injury or death to the user. Units: About 1,900.

title: Plycem Recalls Allura Decking Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
summary: The recalled decking can deteriorate and crack, causing the deck surfacing to break. Consumers can fall through broken decking and suffer serious injuries. Units: About 37,500 boards.

title: Woolino Recalls Children's Pajamas Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The children's pajama sets fail to meet flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 4,100.

title: Sleep Number Recalls Foot Warmers Sold with Sleep Number 360 Smart Beds Due to Burn Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The foot warmer under the mattress cover can short circuit and overheat, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 11,900.

title: Arctic Cat Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Recalled by Textron Specialized Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The winch solenoid located under the operator seat can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 300 ROVs and 3,000 winch accessory kits (In addition, 124 were sold in Canada).

title: Precision Shooting Recalls Archery Crossbows Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The crossbows can fire or discharge unexpectedly, posing an injury hazard to the user and to bystanders. Units: About 17,000.

title: Bush Hog Recalls Riding Lawn Mowers Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The mower blade can separate from the spindle, posing a laceration hazard to the operator or bystanders. Units: About 500.

title: Wholesale Fireworks Recalls Fireworks Due to Violation of Federal Standards; Explosion and Burn Hazards
summary: The recalled fireworks are overloaded with pyrotechnics intended to produce an audible effect, violating the federal regulatory standards for this product. Overloaded fireworks can result in a greater than expected explosion, posing burn and explosion hazards to consumers. Units: About 1,700.

title: Drone Nerds Recalls Self-Balancing Scooters/Hoverboards Due to Fire and Explosion Hazards
summary: The lithium-ion battery packs in the self-balancing scooters/hoverboards can overheat, posing a risk of the products smoking, catching fire and/or exploding. Units: About 700.

summary: The lithium-ion battery packs in the self-balancing scooters/hoverboards can overheat, posing a risk of the products smoking, catching fire and/or exploding. Units: About 1,800.

summary: The lithium-ion battery packs in the self-balancing scooters/hoverboards can overheat, posing a risk of the products smoking, catching fire and/or exploding. Units: About 900.

title: iLive Self-Balancing Scooters/Hoverboards Recalled by Digital Products Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The lithium-ion battery packs in the self-balancing scooters/hoverboards can overheat, posing a risk of the hoverboards smoking, catching fire and/or exploding. Units: About 8,700.

title: Smart Balance Wheel Self-Balancing Scooters/Hoverboards Recalled by Salvage World Due to Explosion and Fire Hazards
summary: The lithium-ion battery packs in the self-balancing scooters/hoverboards can overheat, posing a risk of smoking, catching fire and/or exploding. Units: About 700.

title: Sonic Smart Wheels Self-Balancing Scooters/Hoverboards Recalled by Dollar Mania Due to Explosion and Fire Hazards
summary: The lithium-ion battery packs in the self-balancing scooters/hoverboards can overheat, posing a risk of the products smoking, catching fire and/or exploding. Units: About 1,000.

summary: The lithium-ion battery packs in the self-balancing scooters/hoverboards can overheat, posing a risk of the products smoking, catching fire and/or exploding. Units: About 100.

title: Flos Recalls Pendant Light Fixtures Due to Impact Injury Hazard
summary: The glass diffuser can detach and fall, posing an impact injury hazard. Units: About 4,000.

title: Kubota Recalls RTV-X Series Utility Vehicles Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The seat belt stays can break, posing an injury hazard to consumers in the event of a crash. Units: About 26,900.

title: Natural Solutions for Life Recalls Synodrin Pain Relieving Cream Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Closure Requirement
summary: The packaging is not child resistant as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act. The pain relieving cream contains lidocaine, posing a risk of poisoning to young children. Units: About 56,000.

title: Libbey Glass Recalls Bourbon Glasses Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The glasses can break during normal use, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 229,000.

title: Toys“R”Us Recalls Clay Craft Kits Due to Risk of Mold Exposure; Sold at Babies“R”Us and Toys“R”Us
summary: Mold can be present in the clay, posing a risk of respiratory or other infections in individuals with compromised immune systems, damaged lungs or an allergy to mold. Units: About 6,000.
